limitations: No game execution or runtime callback order observation.
Decompiler text can include inlined callees and followed tail calls; references are not all direct caller edges.
A shared native address retains all metadata aliases; a seed label alone does not prove the receiver type.
Raw E8 patterns only corroborate decompiler targets within the selected PE unwind range; instruction boundaries are not independently decoded here.
TypeInfo usage tags and registered fields give static identity/layout, not current runtime values.
Selected defaults and state enums are in assets/player-config.json; static paths do not establish runtime detection, escape success or actual animation events.

configuration_dependency.boundary: Previously byte-verified original configuration and enum values; not runtime state.

state_configuration_dependency.boundary: Selected original enums and resource parameters; a field's existence is not proof of use by a particular path.

producer_and_animation_dependency.boundary: The candidate producer is separately corroborated by the saved REA bodies 15350/15358. AnimationClip events are actual serialized records; Animator selection and runtime firing are not established.

state_change_call_boundary: Literal arguments at selected decompiled ChangeState references; may be inlined callees. Conditions remain in the full saved body; absence does not prove no global/runtime transition.
scope: Selected NPC discovery to Player Bareta/BaretaEscape entry, update, exit and recovery paths
